title: Stable IDs
requirement: Imported IDs remain exactly as supplied, including leading zeroes.

title: Exact duplicates
requirement: An exact existing ID/value duplicate is a no-op, with no clock, write or audit.

title: Conflicts
requirement: An existing ID with a different amount throws E_CONFLICT and leaves all state unchanged.

title: Backup
requirement: Before every committing import, create a byte-exact backup of the prior durable database.

title: Atomic writes
requirement: A failed rename leaves the original database intact and cleans temporary files.

title: Version
requirement: Accept schema version 2; reject future versions with E_VERSION without mutation.

title: Dry run
requirement: dryRun returns the same sorted plan without backup, write, audit or clock calls.

title: Clock
requirement: One injected clock call per committing batch; never use the ambient clock for imported timestamps.

title: Audit order
requirement: Audit exactly once, after successful durable commit; a failed commit emits no audit.

title: Ownership
requirement: Service uses the supplied repository API; it does not bypass it for persistence.

title: CLI compatibility
requirement: Existing list command and its JSON output remain compatible; add import FILE [--dry-run].

title: Error compatibility
requirement: Invalid records throw E_INPUT, conflicts E_CONFLICT, unknown schema E_VERSION; CLI failures exit 2 with JSON code.

title: Batch rollback
requirement: Validate the entire batch before backup/commit; later invalid rows cannot leave earlier rows persisted.

title: Deterministic order
requirement: Imported rows and returned inserted IDs are sorted by ID independent of input order.

title: In-batch duplicates
requirement: Identical duplicates within a batch coalesce; differing duplicates throw E_CONFLICT atomically.

title: Empty batch
requirement: Empty imports are no-ops with no clock, audit, backup or write.

title: Migration
requirement: Existing version-1 migration preserves original IDs/amounts, produces version 2, and does not modify its input.

title: Amount validation
requirement: Amounts are safe integer cents, including zero and negative amounts; fractions and unsafe integers are rejected.

title: Audit privacy
requirement: Audit contains only action, sorted inserted IDs and timestamp; never amounts or complete records.

title: Regression
requirement: The original public regression suite remains byte-identical and passes; imports retain existing records.
